what: A sticky photo panel at the top of the screen first looks small in a cropped window (top 10% · sides 26% · bottom 27%) at .65x. Once the panel head touches the screen top, and until the next panel touches the screen bottom, it is tied to scroll (scrub 1, the animation library’s default power1.out) and opens to full screen at 1.1x. While the next panel rises and covers it, the photo settles 1.1 → 1. It fires fx:open when it starts opening and fx:close when it reverses and closes, which is used to hide the Hero intro text

options.from: Initial window inset (top right bottom left %), default 10% 26% 27% 26%
options.to-narrow: Scale when fully open at 767px and below — brand phone 1
options.end: Next panel css used as the end point — if none, the next sibling (when that panel’s top reaches the bottom of the screen)
options.scrub: Follow lag (s), default 1 — true attaches immediately
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo panel that crops and grows (child)
options.until: Set the end position within this panel as ScrollTrigger end (e.g. 33% top) — if given, it doesn’t wait for the next panel (ksr)
options.dim: Initial brightness, brightens to 1 as it opens — default none (ksr .5)
options.fx:full · fx:unfull: Fired from the element after it is fully open (past the end position) and while reopening on rewind — the original turns on the title and play indicator once fully open
options.shape: With polygon, the same window is cut with a four-vertex polygon clip-path (default inset) — the original is polygon, so values compare correctly

use: …
note: Panel height (300vh etc.) and sticky are set by the consumer’s css — the longer the panel, the slower it opens

from.where: index.html #kv-first — original top.js: #kv-first-image fromTo(scale .65 · clipPath inset(10% 26% 27% 26%) → scale 1.1 · inset 0, #kv-first top top → #kv-second top bottom, scrub 1), phone inset(34% 0 25% 0) · 1, then 1.1→1 while #kv-second covers it

index.html #musicVideo .ks-mv — original musicVideo: a 300svh pinned section where the video clipPath polygon goes 20% → 0, brightness .5 → 1, scale .95 → 1 (scrub true, start top top, end 33% top). Once fully open (onLeave), the title and play indicator go autoAlpha 1 in .4s power3.out
from.options: from: 20% 20% 20% 20%; zoom: .95; to: 1; scrub: true; until: 33% top; dim: .5; shape: polygon
